newsitem.title: MAURITIUS: Foreigners keep activity high on Mauritius bourse.
newsitem.headline: Foreigners keep activity high on Mauritius bourse.

text.p: Foreign investor trading helped keep volume higher than average on the Mauritius bourse on Wednesday and the SEMDEX market index gained 2.17 points to 367.76, brokers said.
Turnover was posted at 25.14 million rupees on 882,451 shares from 24.90 million rupees on 896,658 shares last Wednesday.
The bourse, which usually trades on Mondays, Wednesdays and Fridays, was closed last Friday and Monday for public holidays.
Brokers said foreign investor trading on Wednesday pushed up prices of leading stocks which prompted the SEMDEX to edge higher.
"Its the usual foreign investor trading in specific blue chips. This type of targeted trading by foreigners has been on since the end of last year," one broker said.

Mauritius Commercial Bank rose 1.50 rupees to 85. Sun Resorts was 80 cents higher to 40.90 rupees on 9,105 shares, New Mauritius Hotels added 30 cents to 33.10 rupees on 192,175 shares and Grand Baie Hotel climbed 30 cents to 40.90 rupees on 57,301 shares.
Happy World Foods was 20 cents higher to 16.90 rupees on 100,000 shares but conglomerate Rogers was unchanged at 96.50 rupees on 4,015 shares.
Building materials manufacturer United Basalt Products (UBP) lost 1.30 rupees to 34.70 rupees on 9,275 shares and investment-based Policy was 10 cents down to 4.00 rupees on 51,183 shares.
